view.claim: AI agents could displace incumbents whose business is selling access to gatekept institutional knowledge, such as legal, medical and personal-finance services, because incumbents struggle to rebuild their products and pricing around agents.

kill_criteria.criterion: Agent-native entrants fail to take meaningful share from incumbents in these categories over several years
